meta.title: Update docs watcher to process changed files only
meta.body_summary: Modify docs watcher to only process a single changed markdown file (and similarly for examples) to speed up docs development iterations.

perf_labels.notes: Codex refactored docs watcher for speed but reintroduced ENOSPC watcher limit error; reviewer CHANGES_REQUESTED and author closed in favor of another branch.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 238 changed lines in one file, this is a small refactor by absolute volume. As a targeted build-tool optimization it should have been low-risk, but it was closed because it reintroduced a previously fixed bug (ENOSPC watcher limit), not because of scale concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer zilto tested the PR locally and found that running `npm start` in `docs/website` brought back the ENOSPC 'System limit for number of file watchers reached' error that had been fixed in #2678. This indicates the watcher change incorrectly handles watcher limits, causing a functional regression.
review_details.performance_claim: Only process a single changed markdown or example file to speed up docs development.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer zilto CHANGES_REQUESTED due to reproduced ENOSPC error; author sh-rp subsequently closed the PR with comment 'closed in favor of branch'.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Node.js watcher limit (ENOSPC) is a known system-level constraint; the agent's refactoring overlooked the need to preserve existing watcher-limit workarounds, leading to a regression.

detection_detail.code_reading: zilto manually tested the PR by running `npm start` and observed the ENOSPC error; provided a full stack trace in the review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Reviewer reproduced the error on their machine and included the exact command and stack trace; no benchmark or profiling for the claimed speedup was provided or requested.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the CHANGES_REQUESTED review, the PR author closed the pull request without attempting a fix, stating it was closed 'in favor of branch'.

core_change_summary.description: Refactors `docs/website/tools/preprocess_docs.js` to watch for file changes and only reprocess the changed document or example rather than synchronizing all files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes confined to a single file; no other files modified.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (a15c4ae): extensive refactor of watcher logic and DRY improvements.
Follow-up commit (cd5c2cb): fixes small errors from codex output.
Reviewer reproduced ENOSPC error; no further commits before close.

review_signals.summary: Reported that `npm start` reintroduced ENOSPC watcher limit error, attaching full stack trace.
review_signals.action_taken: Author closed PR without fixing the regression.

review_signals.summary: Netlify deploy preview for docs site succeeded (unrelated to perf validation).
Closed the PR, stating it was closed in favor of a branch.
